'''Lisandre''' was a [[novice]] in the [[White Tower]] during the [[Aiel War]]. She was from [[Arafel]].

== Appearance ==
She was tall with golden hair spilling down her back.

== History ==
[[Moiraine]] thought that Lisandre would be allowed to test for [[Accepted]] but only if she would be able to cure her sulkiness.

== Speculation ==
Because twenty years have passed, it can be assumed that Lisandre is now a full sister or was sent away from the Tower.
